title: Catalysts without iridium or ruthenium for acidic oxygen evolution
summary: An AI-guided, human-supervised platform assessed 2,942 catalysts and identified complex palladium oxides. InMnPdOx maintained an overpotential below 0.5 V for more than 1,000 hours in sulfuric acid at 10 mA/cm². This is a preprint and laboratory result, without validation in a PEM electrolyzer.
ai_technology: Sequential learning, composition–property models, and LLMs

evidence.tested: Lead catalysts were tested in 1 M H2SO4 at 10 mA/cm2: InMnPdOx kept overpotential below 0.5 V for over 1,000 hours; a retrospective benchmark compared the agent with Bayesian optimization and in-context language-model selection.
evidence.unknown: Testing in a full PEM electrolyzer is not reported, and 'stable' means overpotential under 0.5 V rather than a broader durability assessment.
evidence.ai_role: A sequential-learning agent with ML composition models, adaptive optimization and LLM reasoning ran a human-supervised closed loop with over 90% automation.
